userStories.title: Add the token metric for the CLI source
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a deterministic size metric that a layout change cannot lower, so that each kept loop removes real code.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/cli-loc/scope.txt` lists each path that `git ls-files .agro/cli/src | grep -v '/__tests__/'` prints at the plan commit, one path for each line.
`node .agro/tasks/cli-loc/measure-tokens.mjs` prints one whole number and exits 0. The number is the count of TypeScript tokens in the files of `scope.txt`, without comments and whitespace.
Two runs of `node .agro/tasks/cli-loc/measure-tokens.mjs` print the same number.
In a temporary worktree, a change of only whitespace and line breaks in one scope file leaves the printed number unchanged.
In a temporary worktree, the deletion of each comment in one scope file leaves the printed number unchanged.
In a temporary worktree, the deletion of the body of `.agro/cli/src/lib/tmux.ts` lowers the printed number.
The advisor removes each temporary worktree with `bash .agro/scripts/git-maintenance.sh worktree-remove <path>`.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: executed: scope diff vs git ls-files exit 0 (56 paths); node .agro/tasks/cli-loc/measure-tokens.mjs printed 74255 exit 0, second run 74255; temporary worktree at 78756f0f: whitespace-only change of lib/tmux.ts (file equal after deleting all whitespace) left 74255; deletion of the 6 comments in commands/lifecycle.ts left 74255; deletion of the body of lib/tmux.ts gave 73988 (lower by 267); temporary worktree removed with git-maintenance.sh worktree-remove; pnpm run typecheck exit 0. Advisor review rejected the first scanner-only version 58c1bbb4 (template text after ${...} swallowed code: tmux.ts 43 tokens vs 268 parse-tree leaves); repair 78756f0f counts parse-tree leaf tokens, skipping JSDoc nodes.

userStories.title: Run 5 loops on the CLI source size
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a `/rsi` run on the CLI source so that the CLI gets smaller with no loss of tests or coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Before preflight, the advisor runs `vitest run --coverage` at the start commit and writes the measured passed-test count, uncovered-line count, and uncovered-branch count into the holdout command in place of `<P0>`, `<U0>`, and `<B0>`.
The advisor runs `/rsi` on `task/<N>-cli-loc` with `--loops 5` and `--slug cli-loc-rsi`, with the scope, metric, holdout, and direction in the Summary.
`.agro/tasks/cli-loc-rsi/rsi.tsv` holds 2 baseline rows and 5 loop rows. Each row has 7 columns.
`git diff --quiet <start-commit> -- <evaluator-paths>` exits 0 on the task branch.
`git diff --name-only <start-commit> HEAD` lists only paths in `.agro/tasks/cli-loc/scope.txt` and `.agro/tasks/cli-loc-rsi/rsi.tsv`.
After loop 5, the advisor runs the holdout on the task branch. The holdout prints `0`.
After loop 5, the advisor runs the metric on the task branch. If the ledger holds a `keep` row, the metric is lower than the first baseline metric.
The run report prints one `REVIEW` line for each `keep` row.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: executed: floors measured at the start commit before preflight (vitest --coverage: 2572 passed, uncovered lines 4659-3967=692, uncovered branches 3778-2953=825), filled into the holdout as P0/U0/B0; preflight PASS, holdout 0 at start commit 68fbb68f; /rsi run cli-loc-rsi with 5 loops, baseline 74255 margin 0 (24bd6e98); ledger .agro/tasks/cli-loc-rsi/rsi.tsv has 2 baseline + 5 loop rows, all 7 columns; post-run at 4f73dbc8: git diff --quiet 68fbb68f -- <evaluator-paths> exit 0; git diff --name-only 68fbb68f HEAD lists only cli.ts, commands/harness.ts, commands/langfuse.ts, commands/tool.ts, lib/execution/status.ts (all in scope.txt) and the ledger; holdout rerun 0; metric rerun 73614 < first baseline 74255; report printed RESULT kept 5 of 5 and 5 REVIEW lines; pnpm run typecheck exit 0; 20 of 20 stress suite runs rc=0 with 2572 passed, 0 failed.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the run transcript, the size and coverage totals, and the review checks in one file.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/cli-loc/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the US-001 checks, the preflight output, the baseline readings, each loop evaluation, the run report, and the deletion of each worker worktree and branch.
The evidence file holds the token count and the `wc -l` line count of the scope files at the start commit and at the task branch head.
The evidence file holds the coverage totals for lines, branches, and functions at the start commit and at the task branch head.
For each `keep` row, the evidence file holds the result of the review checklist: removed guard or error handling, removed help or user-visible text, and alias or minifier-style change.
The PR `## Manual review` section lists each `REVIEW` line.
The operator confirms each `REVIEW` line before the merge. The advisor reverts each kept edit that fails the review, and records the revert in `## Lessons`.
`bash .agro/skills/git/scripts/manual-review-check.sh <pr-body-file>` exits 0.
Typecheck passes
